title: Moroccan Orange Slices with Cinnamon and Mint
summary: A simple Moroccan-style dessert of juicy orange slices finished with warming cinnamon and fresh mint. It’s light, fragrant, and best served chilled after a meal.
steps: Cut away the peel and white pith from the oranges, then slice the flesh into rounds or half-moons and arrange on a plate.
Sprinkle the orange slices with sugar, if using, then dust evenly with cinnamon.
Tear the mint leaves and scatter them over the top just before serving.
Serve immediately, or chill for 10 minutes for a colder, more refreshing dessert.
